source.title: Frustrative Nonreward: Behavior, Circuits, Neurochemistry, and Disorders

confidence_rationale: The single strongest anchor for the V3-tractable core of the candidate stream. The Amsel-lineage frustrative-non-reward (FNR) construct is defined by the NEGATIVE DISPARITY BETWEEN OBTAINED AND EXPECTED reward -- an expectation/agency-violation antecedent, NOT noxious input -- and it carries 'aversive motivational properties' with a primary (unconditioned) component, and drives irritability/anger/aggression. That is precisely the smallest computational form the verdict proposes: a blocked-expected-outcome signal distinct from harm, with retained motivation. High source_quality (J Neurosci integrative review); mapping_fidelity high because FNR's antecedent maps almost one-to-one onto REE's z_goal/wanting-vs-realised-outcome discrepancy; transfer_risk moderate (rodent successive-negative-contrast paradigms -> REE).
failure_signatures: FNR is generated with ZERO noxious input -- a merely-omitted or down-shifted reward -- so any REE model that requires z_harm_s/z_harm_un activation to produce a blocked-agency signal contradicts the construct; the antecedent is expectation-violation, not nociception.

FNR is dissociable from the suffering/helplessness pole: it engages reward-circuit deactivation (OFC/ventral striatum/PCC) plus midcingulo-insular/amygdala/PAG ACTIVATION with retained reward-seeking (Type-2 dopamine neurons sustain seeking after non-reward) -- a model that routes blocked-expected-reward straight into withdrawal/shutdown mis-assigns the energised assert pole.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Frustrative non-reward is an emotional response with aversive motivational properties arising from a negative disparity between obtained and expected reward (in quantity or quality); it has primary (unconditioned) and secondary (conditioned) components, engages amygdala/insula/nucleus-accumbens/lateral-habenula/PAG, and is the mechanism whose aberrant form yields irritability ('elevated proneness to anger') across many disorders.
mapping.ree_translation: Supplies the V3-tractable, single-agent core of the candidate stream: a 'blocked-agency / control-failure' signal whose antecedent is REE's own expected-vs-realised outcome discrepancy (z_goal/wanting MECH-112 predicted outcome minus achieved outcome), computed off the existing agency comparator (SD-029), distinct from harm (SD-011) because no noxious input is required. The retained-seeking finding grounds the verdict's controllability-axis split: blocked-expected-reward with motivation INTACT drives assert/persist, not withdrawal.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Rodent consummatory/operant successive-negative-contrast and downshift paradigms; REE has no dopamine/habenula homolog and represents reward expectation abstractly via z_goal/wanting rather than ingestive reward. The transfer is at the level of ANTECEDENT (expected-minus-obtained disparity) and DYNAMICS (aversive-but-motivated), not circuit or neurochemistry. FNR in the literature is reward-omission; REE's blocked-AGENCY extends this to action-outcome omission (intended effect not achieved) -- a faithful but slightly broadened mapping.
mapping.source_context: Integrative review of the frustrative-non-reward literature: consummatory (cSNC) and operant (oSNC) successive-negative-contrast, reward downshift, c-Fos mapping, dopamine heterogeneity, and human irritability fMRI.

confidence_components.notes: Near-ceiling source quality (J Neurosci, canonical Amsel lineage, cross-species convergence noted). mapping_fidelity high: FNR's expected-minus-obtained antecedent and retained-motivation dynamics are exactly what the V3 proxy needs and dissociate it from harm. transfer_risk moderate: ingestive-reward rodent paradigms -> abstract REE reward-expectation, but the load-bearing antecedent transfers cleanly as a computation.
